scope: Build the smallest deterministic, persistence-agnostic Goal lifecycle contract for explicitly caller-supplied goal candidates and explicit adoption/hold/drop transitions. It may validate, freeze, fingerprint, prioritize only caller-supplied bounded fields, and purely evolve goal lifecycle state under exact state-id/generation/state-digest and transition-evidence fences. GOAL_GENERATION, GOAL_ADOPTION, EFFECT_AUTHORIZATION and COMPLETION_VERIFICATION remain distinct: this component must not infer goals, auto-adopt model output, read/write UnifiedDB, evaluate wake conditions, choose Persistent Pulse actions, authorize or execute effects, infer world facts, or mint verified completion. Source plus deterministic tests and public repository CI only; no VPS/physical-GRID10/whole-system credit.
